proposed_artifact.detail: This wrapper records the review boundary for a pending_publish_summary. The individual rows it summarizes live in the sibling packet urn:icn:contract:pending-publish-summary:v1 (docs/contracts/pending-publish-summary.example.json) and are composed by URN, not nested into this object — preview-review.schema.json is additionalProperties:false and defines no field that can carry the rows. Each row would, if approved, be created by a separate, named, documented endpoint; rendering this preview creates nothing. Holder-label to DID binding is a separate documented step under the private-overlay / DID activation flow (icn#1730).
